svg.title: The minimizer for 9 points on the three-sphere: a pentagon with an orthogonal square
svg.desc: Nine points on the unit sphere of four-dimensional space, in a stereographic projection: a regular pentagon on a great circle and a square on the orthogonal great circle. The two great circles appear as two linked circles, which rotate about their common axis. The projection changes the spacing of the points, so the pentagon and the square are also drawn flat, each in the plane of its circle, where the points are evenly spaced. The harmonic energy 35/2 of this configuration is the minimum for 9 points.
svg.text: Harmonic energy of 9 points on S³

text.tspan: Left: both circles in a stereographic projection of S³.
It shows that they are linked, but it changes the spacing
of the points, which is even on each circle.
